channel.title: Santa Cruz Sentinel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Santa Cruz Sentinel (santacruzsentinel.com)

item.title: Santa Cruz hosts Master Recycler Volunteer Training Program
item.description: A group of Santa Cruz city employees is hoping to change consumer behavior through the Master Recycler Volunteer Program. Volunteers attend a series of eight training sessions that cover a variety of topics related to sustainability.

item.title: Medical influencer Attia resigns post at CBS News after name included in multiple Epstein files
item.description: Attia was named last month by CBS News editor-in-chief Bari Weiss as a contributor to network programming.

item.title: Body of civil rights leader Jesse Jackson is to lie in state in South Carolina
item.description: Jackson died after battling a rare neurological disorder that affected his ability to move and talk.

item.title: UC Santa Cruz Ethics Bowl team is heading to national competition
item.description: The UC Santa Cruz Ethics Bowl team is heading to a national competition March 7 and 8 in St. Louis. The seven team members will compete against 35 other teams from around the country, using principles of philosophy and applied ethics to debate thorny cases.

item.title: Photo | Sun shines through morning Fog at Steamer Lane in Santa Cruz
item.description: A window in the morning fog above surfers at Steamer Lane in Santa Cruz Monday provides an opportunity for sunlight to glisten on the Monterey Bay. The subsequent blue skies that covered Santa Cruz County on Monday should return on Wednesday according to the National Weather Service. The weather service forecast calls for rain on Tuesday.

item.title: Volunteers scour the desert for Nancy Guthrie despite authorities urging them to stop
item.description: Experts say volunteers can be helpful but should work under the direction of law enforcement.

item.title: Guest Commentary | Offshore oil will damage Santa Cruz’s home sport: Surfing
item.description: "The thought of oil infrastructure on the horizon, or the risk of spills, chronic leaks, and industrial activity cuts against the community’s values," writes Shaun Burns in a Guest Commentary. "We’ve seen what offshore oil has meant elsewhere in California: beaches closed, marine animals covered in toxic sludge, and years of cleanup."

item.title: Epstein sought to bring entourage of women on 2013 SpaceX visit
item.description: The visit is another example Epstein seeking to ingratiate himself with high-profile people.

item.title: US women’s gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The team said it was “sincerely grateful for the invitation."

item.title: Wondering what’s next for Watsonville’s exiled football coach Manny Contreras | Jim Seimas, Airing It Out
item.description: If exiled football coach Manny Contreras has any desire to stay in the game, at any level, now's the time for him to practice what he, and all coaches, preach to their players after a mess-up: Pick your head up, learn from your mistake, and get ready for the next play.
